create_Normalizer: create a Normalizer instance with a given size, optional group IDs, epsilon, and clip value
record_data_Normalizer: record observation data into the Normalizer to accumulate running sum and sum of squares
update_Normalizer: update the Normalizer mean and standard deviation from recorded data using MPI-reduced aggregates
normalize_data_Normalizer: normalize input data by subtracting the mean and dividing by the standard deviation with clipping
unnormalize_data_Normalizer: unnormalize data by multiplying by the standard deviation and adding the mean back
